# FDG5097

> DO return a Boolean value from custom inequality operators.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 5.7.3 Inequality Operators.

## How it is checked

- Check: fdg (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: FDG5097
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

Message: Return a Boolean value from the inequality operator '{0}'

FDG5097 reports an operator <, >, <= or >= of an externally visible class or struct whose return type is not bool. Interfaces (the generic math operator interfaces, for example) are not reported. Changing the return type of a public operator changes the public API, so the fix is breaking.
